testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, input fields, language switchers, map controls, copy link actions MUST have data-testid in kebab-case format.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_compliance: All neon text on dark backgrounds must maintain at least 4.5:1 ratio. Interactive text states must explicitly specify hover:text-white or hover:text-cyan-300.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Build Tartan as a mobile-first PWA experience with lightweight dark neon design optimized for low-bandwidth networks.
2. Ensure bilingual EN / Somali toggle is fully functional across all components and stateful.
3. Render the S-curve lineage graph dynamically showing the invite chain: 'Who invited you -> YOU -> Direct Joins -> Downstream Count'.
4. Implement an interactive clustered map visualizer with simulated or real-time glowing node arcs across cities like Garowe, Bosaso, Galkayo, Mogadishu, Hargeisa, London, Minneapolis, Dubai.
5. Make sure the share modal includes instant direct actions for WhatsApp, SMS, Native Web Share API, Copy Link, and SVG QR Code.
6. Do NOT use transparent backgrounds without backdrop-blur filters for headers, overlays, or popovers.
7. Include all specified data-testid attributes on key interactive components for verification.
